posts.name: Abhinivesh Sharma
posts.cooked:
Sir, i was there for the exam duration, i viewed the questions, made a subdirectory. Thats the whole criteria for being present as of last terms. I kindly request you to update the OPPE absent status. I did not know we were supposed to make submissions for the exam to actually be counted present.

Sitting for any exam in itself has always been counted as being present for the exam. This is my Re OPPE term sir, please update the status, otherwise I will have to take another term in diploma, and it will really mess with all my current plans and trajectories going forward.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
How can you expect to be given a second chance if you haven’t even tried in first attempt? ReOPPE is for people who tried and failed, not for people who did not attempt. This reattempt is not meant to be gamed.

Given you are already in your second term for SC, it is really not expected for you to not even attempt a single a question.

posts.name: Abhinivesh Sharma
posts.cooked:
Sir, I genuinely didn’t have the bandwidth to attempt the exam on said date, I just wanted to do the bare minimum so I can take it when I actually had the time to study for it, I honestly couldn’t have done the exam due to lots of other factors falling around the same time.

Please reschedule the exam for me, I really do not wish to repeat SC again, it will draw out another term for me in the diploma stages.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Sorry to hear that, but there is nothing really that we can do. These are the grading rules for this course which everyone has to follow. If you are not prepared, you are not meeting the course learning objectives, and thus cannot pass the course. Attempting ReOPPE would not help you as it is going to be harder than this OPPE, it is not meant to be a re-attempt to score high, rather only for students who tried and failed, they need to try harder and they can ‘just-pass’, not score well. OPPE1 was designed for you to score 100/100. If you cannot even make a single submission in that, then we cannot give you a re-attempt (you need to ‘attempt’ to be able to ‘re-attempt’).

Further requests will not be entertained.
